data.name: Master's Yoke
data.description: At 8th level, you can attempt to assert your dominance over any visible creature within 30 feet by declaring the target your property. The target can resist this effect with a successful Will save (DC %1). If the target fails the save, it is affected as if by dominate monster for %2 rounds, save that the target can choose to ignore any order you give and instead take 2 points of Constitution damage and become staggered for 1 round. You can use this ability %3 times per day. This is a language-based mind-affecting effect.|DomainLawDC|DomainLawLVL/2|DomainLawLVL/4-1
